body.message:
The 3BR in Creek Rise Tower 2 is right next door to you, so that keeps your parents close. AED 13,500/month, all-inclusive, and they can start with one month and extend from there.

There's also a 3BR in Creek Gate Tower 1 at the same price if you want a comparison, but Tower 2 is the obvious pick given where you are.

For tomorrow's viewing, what time works best between 9am and 6pm?
